Keep a package's tables as Data Package v1 tabular resources

Source: R/utils.R
dot-as_v1_tabular_resources.Rd

Camtrap DP 1.0.x, and the WildObs profile built on it, follow the Data Package v1 specification, which requires every table to declare profile = "tabular-data-resource". From frictionless 2.0.0, frictionless::add_resource() writes a Data Package v2 resource instead: it sets $schema and type = "table" and leaves profile out, so a Camtrap DP package built with it no longer matches its own profile. This helper puts each resource that has a table schema back in the v1 form. Resources already in that form, as frictionless 1.x writes them, are returned unchanged.

Usage

.as_v1_tabular_resources(dp)

Arguments

dp

A Frictionless data package (a list with resources).

Value

The same data package, with $schema and type removed from each tabular resource and profile set to "tabular-data-resource".

Zachary Amir
